topic: Buying a Mattress with a Hundred-Night Trial

script.title: A HUNDRED-NIGHT TRIAL
script.story_hook: A hundred nights to fall in love with a bed.
script.intro_zh: 一百個晚上，讓你慢慢愛上一張床。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to tonight's mattress store visit. Listen for smart shopping phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到今天的床墊店場景。留意聰明購物的實用說法。
script.outro: That's a mattress bought with your eyes open. Play it again, echo every line.
script.outro_zh: 一張床就這樣買得明明白白。再撥一次，逐句大聲跟讀。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her late twenties with dark brown hair in a single side braid, wearing a moss green wool sweater, black leggings, a small crossbody bag, and an athletic build
script.char_b_description: a man in his fifties with short silver hair combed straight back, thin gold glasses, a navy blue store polo shirt with a name tag, khaki slacks, and a tall lean build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need a mattress that helps my back.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid ə ˈmætrəs ðæt hɛlps maɪ bæk/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要一張對背有幫助的床墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome in, you're in the right aisle.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎進來，您走對走道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I slept badly, my old one is too soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slɛpt ˈbædli maɪ oʊld wʌn ɪz tu sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 我之前都睡不好，那張舊的太軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, so we look at firmer beds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt soʊ wi lʊk æt ˈfɚmɚ bɛdz/
dialogue.zh: 了解，那我們來看看較硬的床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So firmer means really hard?
dialogue.zh: 較硬的意思……是很硬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Firm, medium firm, or plush, three levels.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝm ˈmidɪəm fɝm ɔɹ plʌʃ θɹi ˈlɛvəlz/
dialogue.zh: 有硬、中硬、蓬軟三種等級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, which one do most people pick?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wɪtʃ wʌn du moʊst ˈpipəl pɪk/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，大多數人都選哪一種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium firm, good for back sleepers.
dialogue.zh: 中硬最通用，適合仰睡的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sleep on my side mostly.
dialogue.zh: 可我多半是側著睡的呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then plush, it hugs your shoulders.
dialogue.zh: 那就蓬軟款，它會溫柔托住肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hugs, nice. Can I try this one?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌɡz naɪs kən aɪ traɪ ðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 會托住，真好。我可以試躺這張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, lie down, take your time.
dialogue.zh: 當然，請躺下，慢慢來不著急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, this feels nicer than my bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðɪs filz ˈnaɪsɚ ðæn maɪ bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這張比我家那床還舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it two minutes, still okay?
dialogue.zh: 再躺兩分鐘，還適應嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No complaints, my back approves.
dialogue.zh: 沒什麼意見，我的背在點頭稱許了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great sign, seriously.
dialogue.zh: 這可是好兆頭，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, the price, how much are we talking?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə praɪs haʊ mʌtʃ ɑɹ wi ˈtɔkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 接下來是嚇人的價位，大概要多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight hundred, and that's on sale.
dialogue.zh: 八百美元，而且這已經是特價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a lot for a bed, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə lɑt fɔɹ ə bɛd ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，買張床這價有點貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, but you keep it for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bʌt ju kip ɪt fɔɹ jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 是有點貴，可這張床你要用上許多年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. Hey, does it come with a trial?
dialogue.phonetic: /tru heɪ dʌz ɪt kʌm wɪð ə ˈtɹaɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 也是。對了，它有附試睡期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one hundred nights to decide.
dialogue.zh: 有，一百個晚上讓你慢慢決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hundred nights?
dialogue.zh: 一百個晚上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hundred nights to change your mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈhʌndɹəd naɪts tə tʃeɪndʒ jɔɹ maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 一百個晚上，隨時可以反悔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, sleep on it, then return it?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ slip ɑn ɪt ðɛn ɹɪˈtɜɹn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以我能先睡睡看，不滿意再退掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you sleep on it, literally, for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju slip ɑn ɪt ˈlɪɾɚəli fɔɹ fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 在這張床上你真的能先睡，完全免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free sounds risky, what's the catch?
dialogue.zh: 「免費」聽來有陷阱，條件是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small return fee, ninety dollars.
dialogue.zh: 退貨要收一小筆費用，九十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety only if I give it back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti ˈoʊnli ɪf aɪ ɡɪv ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 九十美元只在我退回去時才收？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, if you keep it, zero.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，願意留下的話就一分不花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I can live with that.
dialogue.zh: 好，這個條件我能接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more thing, the protector.
dialogue.zh: 還有件事，關於保護套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The protector? I saw that box.
dialogue.zh: 保護套嗎？我有看到那個紙箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you must use one, every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ju mʌst juz wʌn ˈɛvɹi naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對，你每晚都必須罩著一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why every single night, though?
dialogue.zh: 可為什麼每一晚都得罩著呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stains void the trial, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪnz vɔɪd ðə ˈtɹaɪəl ðæts ðə ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 沾上污漬，試睡期就作廢，這是規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So no protector, no refund later.
dialogue.zh: 所以不罩保護套，到時就退不了錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, and mind the tag on the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ænd maɪnd ðə tæɡ ɑn ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，還要注意床上的標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The law tag? My mother warned me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɔ tæɡ maɪ ˈmʌðɚ wɔɹnd mi/
dialogue.zh: 那個「法律標籤」嗎？我媽媽也提醒過我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, wise mother, never remove it.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，令堂真有智慧，千萬別撕掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I'll add the protector then.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那我把保護套也一起買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty bucks, waterproof, good quality.
dialogue.zh: 四十美元，防水，品質也不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheaper than I feared, I'll take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃipɚ ðæn aɪ fɪɹd aɪl teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 比我擔心的便宜，我要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice. Now, delivery details?
dialogue.zh: 選得好。接著聊聊送貨的細節？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you haul away my old bed?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hɔl əˈweɪ maɪ oʊld bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 你們會幫我把舊床搬走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, sixty dollars for that.
dialogue.zh: 會的，那項服務要六十美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty to take the old one out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti tə teɪk ði oʊld wʌn aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 六十美元只為搬走舊的那張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they swap it right at your door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðeɪ swɑp ɪt ɹaɪt æt jɔɹ dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，師傅直接在門口替你換新床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I never touch the old mattress?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ ˈnɛvɚ tʌtʃ ði oʊld ˈmætrəs/
dialogue.zh: 那我連舊床墊都不用碰一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, they lift, you just point.
dialogue.zh: 不用，他們出力搬，你只要指個方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, when can you deliver?
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你們最快哪天能送？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday, between nine and one.
dialogue.zh: 週四，上午九點到一點之間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That works, I'll mention it at work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɝks aɪl ˈmɛnʃən ɪt æt wɜɹk/
dialogue.zh: 時間沒問題，我到公司跟主管提一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you want us to text you?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju wɑnt ʌs tə tɛkst ju/
dialogue.zh: 到時要我們傳訊息提醒你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, my phone dies by noon every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ foʊn daɪz baɪ nun ˈɛvɹi ˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我手機每天沒到中午就沒電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll text before the truck leaves.
dialogue.zh: 貨車出發前我們會先傳訊息給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, Thursday, plush plus protector, done.
dialogue.zh: 所以是週四、蓬軟床墊，加保護套，搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set, I'll print your paperwork now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt aɪl prɪnt jɔɹ ˈpeɪpɚˌwɜɹk naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 都辦好了，我這就列印你的單據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for the honest talk.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你全程都這麼坦白地說明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, and enjoy those hundred nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl ænd ɛnˈdʒɔɪ ðoʊz ˈhʌndɹəd naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 好好睡吧，盡情享受那一百個夜晚。

script.youtube_title_en: "Sleep On It, Literally" — Buying a Mattress With a Hundred-Night Trial
script.youtube_description:
「你真能先睡一百晚」——買床墊最怕買錯，那一百晚的試睡體驗到底怎麼用？本集是 60 句沉浸式英文聽力練習，場景就在床墊專賣店的試躺區。

你會聽到：從說明睡眠習慣、挑軟硬等級，到問清試睡期、退貨費、保護套如何讓體驗作廢，一路聽到搬舊床、約送貨與傳訊息確認。整段只用 A2 初級單字，加上美國人每天的自然語感：um、hmm、so、ha、okay。

聽完你就會用：Does it come with...、What's the catch、Can I try this one、Sleep on it。後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱，開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Sleep on it, literally" — buying a mattress feels scary until you know the hundred-night trial rules. This 60-line immersive English listening practice takes place in a mattress store's trial corner.

You will hear: describing your sleep style, choosing firmness, asking about the trial, the return fee, the protector rule that can void the trial, old-bed haul-away, delivery windows, and text confirmations. All in A2 words with real American texture: um, hmm, so, ha, okay.

By the end you'll own lines like Does it come with..., What's the catch, Can I try this one, and sleep on it.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
床墊動不動就幾百美元，萬一睡不習慣怎麼辦？所謂的試睡一百晚，到底是真免費還是行銷花樣？保護套又為什麼能左右你的退貨權？

這一集帶大家走進床墊專賣店，從說明睡眠習慣、試躺挑軟硬，一路聽到試睡期、退貨費、保護套規則、搬舊床與預約送貨，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🛏️ 挑軟硬：Firm, medium firm, or plush, three levels.
🌙 試睡期：One hundred nights to change your mind.
🏷️ 保護套：Stains void the trial, that's the rule.
🚚 約送貨：We'll text before the truck leaves.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、hmm、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用啃文法，多聽就會用。跟著這張床躺滿一百晚，下次自己進店，話就自己開口。

祝你夜夜好眠，買得聰明。
